svg.title: Camera mounting · overhanging load — good and bad mounting
svg.desc: Short overhanging load above the camera: clearance area free. Long overhanging load above the camera: upper clearance area obstructed. The shaded volume represents clearance, not the optical field of view. Not to scale.
svg.text: Shaded volume: clearance area · Red marks: obstruction · Not to scale
